newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Kolosus acquires companies for 26 mln rand.
newsitem.headline: Kolosus acquires companies for 26 mln rand.

text.p: Food and leather producer Kolosus Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it had purchased the entire share capital of Ladysmith Lindgens Leathers and Lindgens Ladysmith Trimming for 25.8 million rand.

Kolosus purchased the shares from Silveroak Industries Ltd -- until mid-1995 a member of the Kolosus group -- after Silveroak acquired the remaining 50 percent in the companies from U.S. company Seton for 12.5 million prior to the sale.

"The acquisition marks another phase in an aggressive strategy of repositioning the Kolosus group as a rand hedge export orientated organisation rather than a predominantly red meat company," said managing director Tito Vorster.
He said the move would boost the group's direct and indirect export earnings from leather to more than 800 milion rands a year.
Kolosus announced earlier this month that is was involved in negotiations with Silveroak to acquire 100 percent of the issued shares in the Lindgens companies.
Vorster added that he expected an announcement soon in connection with Seton's complaint against Kolosus and said he was confident the group would be exonerated.
The South African Competition Board said last year it was investigating the takeover of Silveroak by Kolosus.
